hero.headline: Phone calls without language barriers
hero.subheadline: Vox42 translates your phone calls in real time — you hear everything in your language, your contact in theirs.

steps.title: Open the app
steps.desc: Launch Vox42 on your phone and select your language.

steps.title: Make the call
steps.desc: Call any number worldwide directly from the app.

steps.title: Just talk
steps.desc: Speak naturally — Vox42 translates live in both directions.

steps.title: Read the transcript
steps.desc: After the call, a deletable text transcript is available to you.

languages.title: 12 languages, one app
languages.subtitle: From German to Chinese — Vox42 bridges the world's most common language barriers.

packages.label: Power

pricing.note: Credit never expires. Apple Pay, credit card, and Stripe accepted.

points.title: No audio stored
points.desc: Audio data is processed exclusively for real-time translation and is never stored.

points.title: Deletable transcript
points.desc: You can delete the text transcript of your conversation at any time in the app.

points.title: EU servers
points.desc: All data is processed exclusively on servers within the European Union.

items.a: Vox42 uses state-of-the-art AI translation with over 95% accuracy for supported languages. Quality depends on a clear audio input.
Yes, over a stable mobile data connection (4G/LTE or better), translation works just as well as over Wi-Fi.
Transmission is end-to-end encrypted. Audio data is not permanently stored. Only the optional transcript remains on our EU servers until you delete it.

items.q: Can I use Vox42 in emergencies?
items.a: Vox42 is designed for everyday communication. For medical emergencies, we always recommend using a professional interpreter.

items.q: What does a call cost per minute?
items.a: Costs vary by destination. With the Starter pack (€5) you get around 30 minutes, with Standard (€15) around 100 minutes.
No. Credit you've topped up never expires and remains valid as long as your account is active.
Vox42 currently supports German, English, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Polish, Turkish, Dutch, Russian, Ukrainian, and Chinese.

items.q: How do I top up credit?
items.a: You can top up credit directly in the app via Apple Pay, Google Pay, credit card, or Stripe.
